title: What this delivery changes, in one sentence — this becomes the page title
subtitle: Example · TEST environment · version 1.0.0 · 2026-09-16
intro: What the measurement showed. The numbers taken before the delivery: how many cases change, where, production included. "0" is a number and gets said.
warnings: Step 2 writes for real on TEST (a button that persists). It is intended.

witnesses.proof: select updated_at, funder from folder where reference = 'TEST-001'

steps.title: Setup
where: Open test.example.com and sign in.

expect.text: I am signed in and I can see the list.

steps.title: The nominal case (TEST-001)
where: Folder TEST-001 → tab Technical → the card named exactly as on screen.
do: One click per line: click Analyse.
Wait until the button reads Analyse again.

expect.text: The line reads exactly: Label copied from the code, accents included or not.
One fact per line: the My box checkbox is ticked.

steps.title: The gesture that lifts the red

verify.text: select updated_at, funder from folder where reference = 'TEST-001' — updated_at must be later than the run

do: Come back to the folder with the browser's back button.

expect.text: The My box checkbox is now ticked.
Positive control: TEST-002 is unchanged — its box was already ticked and no link appeared.

text: What did not change: no migration, and the deployment touched no data.
What waits for a decision: name it here, or say there is none.

authorNotes: Free field for the agent who wrote this: doubts, witnesses not yet measured, labels to confirm. The page ignores it; the reviewer reads it.
